summary: Blind adversarial sweep of validateGameSaveShape + restoreGameSession at pin 97f1878b: 21 probe tests (game/src/probes/saveFalsification.probe.test.ts, run `cd game && npx vitest run src/probes/saveFalsification.probe.test.ts`) - 11 failing = confirmed mints, 10 passing = HOLD pins. Registry-membership preflight (materials/pills/buildings/sites/techniques), the closed modifier-witness set, the technique-holder contract, F-SKL-1 skill producer check, and the levelled-skill core axis all hold. The concentrated defect cluster is the equipment validator: it checks enum membership and per-field legality but never crosses item template/quality claims against the authored roll envelopes (slot lists, grade-vs-realm, affix slot policy, dup stats, pool ceilings), so forged items mint modifiers no authored roller produces. Second cluster is ledger-free claims: attributePoints vs baseStats are bounded independently but the spent-AP ledger does not exist, so both mint; duplicated non-creation talent ids dodge both count bounds and double-apply effects. Two Low self-harm mints (negative mainStat/baseStats) and one Low currency-class admission (unbounded skillInsight) are recorded honestly.

findings.title: Equipped item grade is checked against the enum only, never against the player realm (canUseItemGrade is strict realm==grade; no writer equips a mismatched item)
findings.reproduction: Probe F-EQ-GRADE-REALM: mortal save + equipped base_kiem with grade 'bat_pham'. validateGameSaveShape ok, restoreGameSession status 'ok', and setEquipmentModifiers mints the might modifier from a weapon the mortal realm could never equip.

findings.title: Affix slot policy enforced only when the affix declares a raw `slots` array; most affixes leave it undefined so slot-forbidden stats (e.g. maxHp on a weapon) mint
findings.reproduction: Probe F-EQ-AFFIX-SLOT: equipped base_kiem carries affix prefix_max_hp (registry-normalized slots forbid maxHp on weapon, but affixes.ts leaves `slots` undefined so saveShapeValidation.ts:3071-3085 skips the check). Admitted; restore mints maxHp on a weapon - no roller output ever contains it.

findings.title: Duplicate affix stats on one item are unbounded (only GLOBAL_MAX_AFFIXES=8 count is checked); rollAffixes' excludeStats makes stat duplication unproducible
findings.reproduction: Probe F-EQ-AFFIX-DUP test 1: equipped base_kiem with two prefix_max_hp affix entries. Admitted and restored; two live maxHp modifiers minted where the roller can produce at most one.

findings.title: An affix claiming the item's mainStat stat is admitted; rollAffixes seeds excludeStats with mainStat.stat so the overlap is unproducible
findings.reproduction: Probe F-EQ-AFFIX-DUP test 2: might-mainStat base_kiem + prefix_attack (might) affix. Admitted; mints a might affix on top of the might main stat.

findings.title: Quality envelopes unenforced: a hoang item admits a supreme-pool affix, affix tier above the quality cap, more affixes than ITEM_QUALITY_SUBSTATS_RANGE allows, and per-tier values mint at union-max via getEffectiveAffixValue
findings.reproduction: Probe F-EQ-AFFIX-ENVELOPE: hoang-quality base_kiem claiming prefix_supreme_final_damage at tier 5 plus a tier-3 prefix_max_hp (hoang allows 1 substat at tier 1 in the basic pool). Admitted; getEffectiveAffixValue (EquipmentRollPrimitives.ts:51-67) normalizes each forged tier against the union of authored tiers, minting real modifiers.

findings.title: equipment[].slot is enum-checked but never checked against the item template's allowed slot - a weapon claimed in 'helmet' mints its modifiers from that slot
findings.reproduction: Probe F-EQ-FOREIGN-SLOT: equipped base_kiem with slot 'helmet'. Admitted; restore occupies the helmet slot and mints the weapon's might modifier.

findings.title: attributePoints and baseStats are bounded independently (AP <= globalLevel, stats clamped to realm cap) but no spent-AP ledger exists, so capped stats AND the full unspent AP pool mint together
findings.reproduction: Probe F-AP-DOUBLE-COUNT: mortal realmLevel 18, all baseStats already at 10 (cap), and attributePoints 18 unspent. Admitted; restore keeps capped stats plus 18 unspent points - ~2x the authored stat budget no allocation sequence produces.

findings.title: selectedTalentIds has no dedup check: a duplicated POOL talent id (not in CREATION_TALENT_IDS) dodges both the creation-count and maxTalentPicks bounds, and collectTalentEffects double-applies it
findings.reproduction: Probe F-TALENT-DUP: qi_refining save with selectedTalentIds=['lk_dung_nap','lk_dung_nap']. Admitted (count 2 <= 1+realmIndex 2; creation count 0); restore keeps both ids and getCultivationSpeedMultiplier returns 1.2 vs the authored 1.1 max at level 1. Writer push(decision.talentId) is guarded by !includes, so the dup is unproducible.

findings.title: mainStat.flat has only an upper bound (<= maxFlat); negative values admit and mint a negative modifier - self-harm only
findings.reproduction: Probe F-EQ-MAINSTAT-NEG: equipped base_kiem mainStat flat -50. Admitted; mints -50 might. No authored writer emits a negative flat, but the mint only harms the character.

findings.title: baseStats values are only checked finite; a negative stat claim is admitted and the restore clamp min(cap, v) preserves it - self-harm only
findings.reproduction: Probe F-BASESTATS-NEG: mortal save with baseStats.might = -50. Admitted; player.baseStats.might stays -50 after restore.

findings.title: skillInsight/totalSkillInsightGained accept any non-negative finite magnitude - currency-class admission (producible in principle, magnitude unverifiable)
findings.reproduction: Probe F-INSIGHT-UNBOUNDED: mortal save claiming skillInsight=totalSkillInsightGained=1e9. Admitted and restored verbatim. Insight spends on skill depth, so the claim mints purchasing power no session could accrue - Low because currency magnitudes are inherently unverifiable, same class as cultivation.
